resources.string: Lower media volume when a door opens
Keeps playback going and restores the volume when all doors close. Set the level in Sound and media.
Pause when the driver’s door opens
Uses the driver’s door reading while parked on compatible vehicle software.
Pause on sleep and resume on wake
Resumes the same player and track if Controls paused it and playback has stayed unchanged.
Enable the Controls accessibility service to keep this option running in the background.
Give Controls notification access to read and control the active music player.
